subject: Future Tech
title: Nanoparticles vs. Cancer
description: A quick win: understand Nanoparticles vs. Cancer.

hook.text: Gold nanoparticles absorb infrared light and heat up.

buildup.text: Photothermal therapy uses nanoparticles as tiny heaters.

discovery.text: Iron oxide nanoparticles can be guided by magnets to tumors, then heated with alternating magnetic fields.

twist.text: Nanoparticles can also deliver two therapies at once: chemo inside and heat outside. Double attack, one carrier.

climax.text: Clinical trials show nanoparticle therapies reducing tumor sizes with fewer side effects than standard chemo alone.

punchline.text: Particles too small to see, fighting the biggest disease.

quiz.question: How does photothermal therapy using gold nanoparticles work?
options: Nanoparticles absorb laser light and heat cancer cells
Gold reflects radiation away from healthy cells
